name: THE LETTER-WRITER
note: Doc 07 #1. Writes letters home for men who can't. Charges by the page. Resolves the notice board hotspot. Doing better than anyone, because he sells the one thing that never runs out.

barks.R_NOBODY: Letters home. Ten cents the page.
barks.R_SWINDLED: Letters home. Might want to leave a bit out.
barks.R_RACCOON: I could make the raccoon sound better.
barks.R_SURVEYED: ‘Had my land surveyed by a professional.’ See? Free of charge.
barks.R_BORDERS_MOTT: Now you’ve got something to write about. Twenty cents.
barks.R_LOST_DUEL: I’d leave the duel out entirely.
barks.R_WON_DUEL: Beat Deke Vessel. That’s a page and a half right there.
barks.R_DEAD: Do you want me to write to her, or would that be strange?
barks.R_TRUTH: Twelve years I’ve been making things up on this street and you did it in one afternoon.
